subject.title: Feishu card action: pass through form_value, input_value and other fields

question: What Feishu card-action payload contract should OpenClaw support for callback fields that are siblings of `action.value`?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the exact agent-facing shape affects channel message semantics and compatibility for existing button-command flows.

options.title: Structured additive payload
options.body: Expose form/input/select callbacks as structured JSON while leaving simple button text and command extraction unchanged.

options.title: Command-argument append
options.body: Append selected callback fields into the existing command text path, reducing parser churn but losing a richer envelope.

options.title: Defer callback expansion
options.body: Keep only `action.value` support until maintainers choose a broader Feishu interaction contract.

recommendation.title: Structured additive payload
recommendation.body: Expose form/input/select callbacks as structured JSON while leaving simple button text and command extraction unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is specific to the Feishu/Lark plugin’s agent-visible callback contract, and the plugin metadata names this handle as the community maintainer.
